label.purpose: Title-block cells and table heads only.

subhead.purpose: Panel titles, plan names, big title-block values.

ui.purpose: Field labels, legends, secondary UI text.

small.purpose: Status marks, hints, fine print. The floor for anything with safety meaning.

motion.name: plot
motion.purpose: Ink plots over always-visible construction lines once on load and on vessel-type change.

narrative.northStar: The safety plan on the wheelhouse wall.

rules.name: The Safety Sign Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only with its ISO safety meaning: fire red for overdue, danger and fire equipment; lifesaving green for done, on track and lifesaving equipment; caution yellow for due soon and the deadline highlight; mandatory blue for links and focus. Never use them decoratively.

rules.name: The Yellow Needs Ink Rule
rules.body: Caution yellow always sits with ink text or an ink outline, never white text.

rules.name: The Meaning Floor Rule
rules.body: Status marks (overdue, due soon, done) are the most important words on a screen; they never go below Small.
